description: This file defines the BasicWorkSchedule class which implements work scheduling logic within the OrangeHRM system. It handles employee work shifts, holidays, non-working days, and related configurations, acting as a core part of the leave and work schedule management modules.

classes.name: BasicWorkSchedule
classes.description: Implements work schedule functionalities such as shift times, non-working days, and holidays for employees within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getWorkShiftService
methods.description: Retrieves the WorkShiftService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with this schedule.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for this schedule.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the employee's work shift, defaulting if no custom shift is set.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Retrieves the start and end times for the employee's work shift.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determines if a given day is a non-working day.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is marked as a half-day holiday.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day holiday.
